For years, I tried to catch every word on calls with American investors, and I always got lost. Then a mentor told me: stop translating, and listen for the signals. When someone says having said that, a problem is coming. When they say to put it differently, you get a second chance. Now, when I miss something, I just say: if I understood correctly, you are saying that. Nobody has ever thought less of me. Most of the time, they explain it again, more slowly.
